newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar firms to 470.75/471.75 per dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar firms to 470.75/471.75 per dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar firmed to 470.75/471.75 per dollar despite a 204-basis-point drop in yields on benchmark six-month Central Bank TEM bills, traders said.
The unit closed Tuesday at 471.75/472.75 per dollar
"The market had a lot of dollars offered, even as demand was low," said one trader. "The Central Bank was very quiet."
New York-based IDEA meanwhile said continuing stability of the exchange rate despite the drop in TEM yields was evidence of a steep domestic recession.

"The lack of demand for dollars, in spite of sharply negative interest rates and continued real appreciation of the bolivar, suggests the recessionary impact of Venezuelan Agenda has been greater than expected," it wrote in a market commentary.
Caracas-based traders were divided as to whether Thursday trade would see the bolivar firm again, or weaken on the TEM yield drop.
